entries.dialogueText: "Valero agreed to go through the trials that I proposed. I fear what may come, yet I remain steadfast in the knowledge that the prophesied king will eventually return."

entries.title: Narrator: ""October 24th, sunset.""
entries.dialogueText: "October 24th, sunset."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: "October 16th, late afternoon."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: "November 1st, close to midnight."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""It's hard to believe the king has..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's hard to believe the king has entrusted me with this sacred task. Sometimes I think that I take his faith in me for granted."

entries.title: Narrator: ""We will see if he is the one. I pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will see if he is the one. I pray that it is true. I must up the dosage further. We are getting closer."

entries.title: Narrator: ""While he exhibits signs of joy and..."
entries.dialogueText: "While he exhibits signs of joy and laughter, it appears that the dosage is insufficient. I will augment it."

entries.dialogueText: "The King is having convulsions. The dosage might be too high. But we are so close."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""November 18th, late evening.""
entries.dialogueText: "November 18th, late evening."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""The king whispered my name before..."
entries.dialogueText: "The king whispered my name before I left his chambers. It still echoes in my head. 'Sal, Sal... look after Romus.'"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Not long after administering the f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not long after administering the final dose, I knew something was wrong -- a darkness began consuming him as if he had been cursed!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Everything depends on this now. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything depends on this now. I will administer the final dose on the 18th. Oh God, I pray to you for a successful outcome."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Valero was not the chosen one. I h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valero was not the chosen one. I have failed. Perhaps his son. Time will tell."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Arrest the Grand Wiseman immediate..."
entries.dialogueText: "Arrest the Grand Wiseman immediately and throw him in prison to rot."

entries.dialogueText: "Bring him to me. I will talk to him first."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "If it were up to me, I'd say he should be arrested for treason against the Crown."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "I find it hard to believe the Grand Wiseman could be guilty of such treason. But the evidence speaks for itself..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "This is... unexpected, but I shall abide by your command, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "This is... not the direction I'd expected you to take."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She bowed and left the room."
entries.dialogueText: She bowed and left the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed and left the room."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed and left the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alone in the room where my father p..."
entries.dialogueText: Alone in the room where my father passed, I wondered if arresting Sal was the right decision.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Did I act justly, or was I swayed b..."
entries.dialogueText: Did I act justly, or was I swayed by personal feelings?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And if Sal didn't kill my father......"
entries.dialogueText: And if Sal didn't kill my father... who did?

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'll fetch him at once, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll fetch him at once, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'll bring him at once, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll bring him at once, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Here you are, Your Majesty. We brought him to you as ordered."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Here you are, Your Majesty, as instructed."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: The guards held Sal firmly by both arms.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Everyone except Sal. Out. I wish to speak to him in private."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Keep him close in case he tries an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Keep him close in case he tries anything."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It took a few tries to convince eve..."
entries.dialogueText: It took a few tries to convince everyone to leave. Eventually, though, Sal and I were alone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards held his arms tighter."
entries.dialogueText: The guards held his arms tighter.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On seeing the journal in my hands,..."
entries.dialogueText: On seeing the journal in my hands, Sal's eyes filled with fear.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why did you give my father that po..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why did you give my father that poison?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why should I spare you?""
entries.dialogueText: "Why should I spare you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Tell me more about this prophecy you were trying to fulfill."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: “Do you feel remorse for what you've done?”

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It is not poison, Your Majesty. As..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not poison, Your Majesty. As you have already witnessed, it is a tool to prepare one's mind to receive the gift of foresight."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""When a Grand Wiseman such as mysel..."
entries.dialogueText: "When a Grand Wiseman such as myself partakes of it, such visions come in flashes, their meaning shrouded in mystery."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Unfortunately, that did not transp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, that did not transpire with His Majesty Valero."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You are insane, Grand Wiseman. Pur..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are insane, Grand Wiseman. Pure and simple."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I cannot believe a psychoactive su..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot believe a psychoactive substance would play such a significant role in our religion."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Because there is still hope, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "Because there is still hope, Romus."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your father may not have been the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your father may not have been the one, but as it is foretold, it may very well be you!"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Do what you must, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Do what you must, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I am a humble servant of God and h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am a humble servant of God and he alone knows my path."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The prophecy is real. All the even..."
entries.dialogueText: "The prophecy is real. All the events are falling into place."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Did God tell you to murder the mon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did God tell you to murder the monarch of Rizia, kingslayer?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""What kind of God commands a man to..."
entries.dialogueText: "What kind of God commands a man to slay his king?"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""'Beneath the watchful gaze of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Beneath the watchful gaze of the ancients, upon the hallowed altar, the king will partake of the sacred draught, its composition known only to the cloistered few.'"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""'As the elixir courses through his..."
entries.dialogueText: "'As the elixir courses through his veins, the world around him shall dissolve.'"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""'In this expanse, the whispers of..."
entries.dialogueText: "'In this expanse, the whispers of the ancients will foretell the trials and triumphs of his reign.'"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius

entries.dialogueText: "'Amidst this ethereal void, a silhouette will emerge, a boy, born of his lineage, reaching for a crown that dances like a flame...'"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""This has been passed down for cent..."
entries.dialogueText: "This has been passed down for centuries, Your Majesty, and I shall recite it to you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Such bullshit.... How dare you call yourself a priest."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As a Wruhecist myself, this smells..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a Wruhecist myself, this smells strongly to me of heresy. And you dare call yourself a priest..."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Valero was kind... and a friend, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valero was kind... and a friend, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""One of the few I could call upon...."
entries.dialogueText: "One of the few I could call upon. He entrusted his life to me, and I failed him..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes, you did.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, you did."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""God will never forgive you.""
entries.dialogueText: "God will never forgive you."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""What happened with your father was..."
entries.dialogueText: "What happened with your father was a tragedy, but his death doesn't have to be in vain."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""By keeping the faith, together we..."
entries.dialogueText: "By keeping the faith, together we will unlock the secrets to Rizia’s glory and her salvation!”

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't care what he has or hasn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't care what he has or hasn't done. You're not to mention a word of this to anyone. Sal walks free."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I do. Every day, I offer prayers t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do. Every day, I offer prayers to God for forgiveness."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Arrest Grand Wiseman Sal Ignacius..."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""It can't be. The Grand Wiseman of..."
entries.dialogueText: "It can't be. The Grand Wiseman of the Wruhecist Sanctuary of Rizia would never do such a thing. Tell him, Grand Wiseman..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal quietly shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: Sal quietly shook his head.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Grand Wiseman played us all fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Grand Wiseman played us all for fools. He shall be placed under immediate arrest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, Sal administered the drug tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Sal administered the drug that ended my father's life. But he did so out of love for God and for this country. He shall walk free."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The others gasped."
entries.dialogueText: The others gasped.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father was weak, Captain Castel..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father was weak, Captain Castellanus. He had to die so that Rizia could be reborn. The Grand Wiseman's actions were entirely justified."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""This shall stay between us, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "This shall stay between us, Your Majesty. The other Wruhec's Guardians don't have to know."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sevrio bowed and followed Sal out."
entries.dialogueText: Sevrio bowed and followed Sal out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sevrio turned to me, seemingly in a..."
entries.dialogueText: Sevrio turned to me, seemingly in a daze.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""He was my teacher. My mentor. And..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was my teacher. My mentor. And all this time, he was a fraud."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He violently tore off the gold chai..."
entries.dialogueText: He violently tore off the gold chain that was hanging around his neck.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Wruhec's Guardians were built on a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wruhec's Guardians were built on a foundation of lies. We must disband."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""It has been an honor serving you,..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has been an honor serving you, Your Majesty. Despite everything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You still have the Wruhecist commu..."
entries.dialogueText: "You still have the Wruhecist community's respect. I need you to make sure they weather this scandal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, Sevrio. You're dismisse..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Sevrio. You're dismissed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go with God.""
entries.dialogueText: "Go with God."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With Sal gone, Rizia is in the mar..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Sal gone, Rizia is in the market for a new Grand Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""I-- I could never. Not after this.""
entries.dialogueText: "I-- I could never. Not after this."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Divus zaitu.""
entries.dialogueText: "Divus zaitu."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""I will talk to them. But I cannot..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will talk to them. But I cannot promise they'll listen."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed his head and rushed out."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed his head and rushed out.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""His guilt? What did he do?""
entries.dialogueText: "His guilt? What did he do?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing less than his duty. My fat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing less than his duty. My father had to die so that Rizia could be reborn. The Grand Wiseman's actions were entirely justified."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As I said, this is all a misunders..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I said, this is all a misunderstanding. The Grand Wiseman is to be released immediately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father asked him to assist in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father asked him to assist in the conduction of a sacred ritual. The fact that the ritual took his life is no fault of Sal's."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sevrio's jaw dropped."
entries.dialogueText: Sevrio's jaw dropped.
